name: overleaf-latex
description: Create, edit and compile LaTeX documents in your signed-in Overleaf account.

interface.shortDescription: Create and compile LaTeX in Overleaf.
interface.longDescription: Work with your Overleaf projects through nine MCP tools: find and create projects, read and edit source with version checks, organize files, compile LaTeX, and retrieve PDFs and logs. Uses your locally saved Overleaf browser session, including accounts signed in through Google. An independent personal integration.
